overview: Studying Automobile Engineering - PG in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: What is the tuition fee for Automobile Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Annual tuition fees range from €11,500 to €17,000 (around ₹12.49 lakh to ₹18.46 lakh). Universities offer competitive merit scholarships covering 50% to 100% of tuition fees.

faq.question: Is IELTS required to study Automobile Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: English proficiency is mandatory for English-taught programmes. Universities accept IELTS Academic (typically 6.5+), TOEFL iBT (92+), and PTE Academic (62+).
